operations.name: init
operations.title: Initialize Ledger
operations.description: Create .ledger/ and optional docs scaffolding in the current directory.

operations.name: adopt
operations.title: Adopt Ledger
operations.description: Initialize Ledger for an established repository with partial docs adoption.

operations.name: new
operations.title: Create a change entry
operations.description: Create the next numbered change entry from the template.

operations.name: feedback
operations.title: Create a product note
operations.description: Create a product-note record for dogfood findings and product observations.

operations.name: backlog.new
operations.title: Create a backlog item
operations.description: Create the next numbered backlog item from the template.

decisions.description: Decision ids the item depends on.

docs.description: Durable docs the item relates to.

operations.name: decision.new
operations.title: Create a decision record
operations.description: Create the next numbered decision record from the template.

decisions.description: Decision ids this decision builds on.

operations.name: promote
operations.title: Promote a backlog item
operations.description: Create a linked draft change entry from a backlog item and update the item in one transaction.

id.description: Backlog item id, for example B007.

title.description: Entry title. Defaults to the item title.

areas.description: Area tags. Defaults to the item areas.

sourceStatus.description: Status written to the promoted item. Defaults to in-progress.

operations.name: session.start
operations.title: Start a session record
operations.description: Start an expiring session record, or return the active one for the same host session.

title.description: Session title. Defaults to the host and date.

id.description: Session record id, for example S0001.

hostSession.description: Host session identifier stored in the record.

operations.name: session.touch
operations.title: Record touched paths
operations.description: Record touched paths on the active session record, starting one when none exists.

host.description: Agent host used when a session must be started.

id.description: Session record id, for example S0001.

hostSession.description: Host session identifier stored in the record.

operations.name: session.note
operations.title: Add a session note
operations.description: Append a bullet to the Learned, Next, or Summary section of the active session.

section.description: Section to append to. Defaults to Learned.

id.description: Session record id, for example S0001.

hostSession.description: Host session identifier stored in the record.

operations.name: session.close
operations.title: Close a session record
operations.description: Mark the active session record closed.

id.description: Session record id, for example S0001.

hostSession.description: Host session identifier stored in the record.

operations.name: session.prune
operations.title: Prune expired sessions
operations.description: List expired session records and delete them with --write.

operations.name: validate
operations.title: Validate Ledger records
operations.description: Validate Ledger source records and return errors and warnings.

updateBaseline.description: Record current warnings in the validation baseline.

operations.name: ready
operations.title: Check records are ready to land
operations.description: Check that draft records have no TODOs or template placeholders and carry verification, invariants, docs impact, and valid references.

targets.description: Record ids or paths. Defaults to draft change entries.

kind.description: Kind filter for the default selection.

status.description: Status filter for the default selection. Defaults to draft.

targets.description: Record ids or paths. Defaults to draft change entries.

kind.description: Kind filter for the default selection.

status.description: Status filter for the default selection. Defaults to draft.

operations.name: index
operations.title: Write Ledger indexes
operations.description: Validate records and write JSON indexes under .ledger/indexes.

operations.name: verify-integrity
operations.title: Verify Ledger integrity
operations.description: Return source record hashes and a deterministic catalog hash.

check.description: Compare current records with the existing integrity baseline without replacing it.
Compare current records with the existing integrity baseline without replacing it.

operations.name: render
operations.title: Render the static reader
operations.description: Build the offline static reader plus search and graph JSON artifacts.

operations.name: serve
operations.title: Serve the static reader
operations.description: Render and serve the static reader on loopback, optionally with the engine API.

watch.description: Rebuild when Ledger source records change.

expose.description: Allow a non-loopback host with a required token.

api.description: Also serve the JSON API, event stream, and MCP over HTTP.

operations.name: coverage
operations.title: Check Ledger coverage
operations.description: Check changed files against git.requireEntryFor and Ledger file coverage.

base.description: Base revision for a merge-base range.

head.description: Head revision for a merge-base range.

explain.description: Explain each changed path's coverage status.

base.description: Base revision for a merge-base range.

head.description: Head revision for a merge-base range.

explain.description: Explain each changed path's coverage status.

operations.name: ci
operations.title: Run Ledger CI checks
operations.description: Run validation, docs audit, coverage, and docs impact as one check.

base.description: Base revision for a merge-base range.

head.description: Head revision for a merge-base range.

base.description: Base revision for a merge-base range.

head.description: Head revision for a merge-base range.

operations.name: doctor
operations.title: Check Ledger health
operations.description: Check workspace health, Git availability, validation, docs, indexes, render output, and stale signals.

operations.name: metrics
operations.title: Measure Ledger performance
operations.description: Measure read, validate, index, render-model, and search latency against budgets.

operations.name: stale
operations.title: Find stale knowledge
operations.description: Find stale knowledge signals such as missing references, stale symbols, and release verification gaps.

check.description: Exit non-zero when stale signals exist.
Exit non-zero when stale signals exist.

operations.name: cache.status
operations.title: Show catalog cache status
operations.description: Report the catalog cache backend, size, and freshness.

operations.name: cache.warm
operations.title: Warm the catalog cache
operations.description: Read every source record so the catalog cache is current.

operations.name: cache.clear
operations.title: Clear the catalog cache
operations.description: Delete the catalog cache; the next read rebuilds it from source records.

operations.name: conflict
operations.title: Get conflict guidance
operations.description: Return conflict rules, invariants, and verification for paths.

operations.name: explain
operations.title: Explain file history
operations.description: Return Ledger records that mention a file path.

operations.name: search
operations.title: Search Ledger records
operations.description: Run weighted fuzzy search over the static reader search fields.

operations.name: search-packet
operations.title: Build search agent packet
operations.description: Return compact agent handoff context from weighted Ledger search results.

query.description: Search query to package for agent context.

budgetTokens.description: Approximate token budget for the returned packet.

query.description: Search query to package for agent context.

budgetTokens.description: Approximate token budget for the returned packet.

operations.name: query
operations.title: Query Ledger records
operations.description: Filter Ledger records by metadata, relationships, paths, and text.

operations.name: packet
operations.title: Build agent packet
operations.description: Return compact agent handoff context for a file path.

path.description: File path to package for agent context.

budgetTokens.description: Approximate token budget for the returned packet.

path.description: File path to package for agent context.

budgetTokens.description: Approximate token budget for the returned packet.

operations.name: mcp
operations.title: Start the MCP server
operations.description: Start a stdio Model Context Protocol server exposing Ledger tools for agents.

operations.name: unreleased
operations.title: List unreleased changes
operations.description: List landed or shipped change entries without a release assignment.

operations.name: release
operations.title: Build a release record
operations.description: Render a Ledger release record and optionally assign entries and write the file.

assign.description: Write the release version back to selected entries.

operations.name: release.notes
operations.title: Print release notes
operations.description: Print the Public Notes of a release record for changelogs and GitHub Releases.

operations.name: migrate.changelog
operations.title: Migrate a changelog
operations.description: Migrate legacy Markdown changelog records into .ledger/entries.

rewriteDocs.description: Rewrite docs references to new entry paths.

status.description: Status to assign to migrated entries.

operations.name: agents
operations.title: Print agent instructions
operations.description: Print ready-to-paste AGENTS.md instructions for the configured Ledger workflow.

role.description: Agent role to tailor the instructions for.

operations.name: docs.audit
operations.title: Audit docs references
operations.description: Classify the docs root and report Ledger-to-doc references.

operations.name: docs.check
operations.title: Check docs references
operations.description: Audit docs references and fail when Ledger references docs that do not exist.

operations.name: docs.classify
operations.title: Classify docs paths
operations.description: Classify docs paths as durable, routing, scratch, generated, or unknown.

paths.description: Docs paths to classify. Classifies the docs root when omitted.
Docs paths to classify. Classifies the docs root when omitted.

operations.name: docs.impact
operations.title: Check docs impact
operations.description: Return docs impact for changed files or the current git diff.

base.description: Base revision for a merge-base range.

head.description: Head revision for a merge-base range.

check.description: Exit non-zero when source files lack docs impact.

changedFiles.description: Changed files to inspect. Uses git when omitted.
Changed files to inspect. Uses git status when omitted.

staged.description: Use staged git diff when changedFiles is omitted.

operations.name: docs.reconcile
operations.title: Reconcile docs routing
operations.description: Regenerate the docs routing manifest and START_HERE file from the docs audit.

operations.name: docs.migrate
operations.title: Write docs migration report
operations.description: Write cleanup and organization guidance for the docs root.
